usage.primary: Main CTA buttons, active states, key highlights

layout.structure: Sidebar (Left, Fixed, Icon-only/Narrow) + Main Content (Right, Scrollable)
layout.grid_system: Responsive grid (1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 3/4 col desktop)

cards.style: bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for Sidebar and Sticky Headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-r border-border/50
visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle orange glow gradients behind key elements or in empty states
visual_enhancers.shadows: Colored shadows for primary actions: shadow-orange-500/20

instructions_to_main_agent: UPDATE /app/frontend/src/index.css with the new color palette variables defined in 'colors.palette'. REPLACE the existing purple/rose colors with the Orange (#f97316) theme.
ENSURE the Sidebar is implemented as a fixed, narrow component on the left with glassmorphism effect.
CREATE a 'Welcome Header' component that uses the 'header_bg' image with a dark gradient overlay so text is readable.
USE 'Manrope' for all body text and 'Chivo' for headings.
IMPLEMENT the 'Quick Start' section as a grid of cards with icons.
IMPLEMENT the 'Updates' section as a list of recent activities.
ENSURE all interactive elements have hover states using the orange accent.
USE the provided image URLs for avatars and backgrounds.
DO NOT use gradients for the main background; keep it solid dark (#09090b) or very subtle noise.
universal_guidelines: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
